In laboratory, carbon dioxide gas can be prepared by the action of dilute hydroploric acid on marble chips.
The chemical reaction can be shown as calcium carbonate plus hydropluric acid gives calcium chloride, water and carbon dioxide.
The carbon dioxide gas is collected by upward displacement of air because it is heavier than here.
An apparatus chemical is required for this is shown in the diagram.
We can confirm the prepared gas is carbon dioxide when we add or keep the most blue it must be put in the gas jar, it turns into red color.

It is due to formation of insoluble calcium carbonate.

Carbon dioxide gas fill the balloon, fall downward or move downward in atmosphere.
It is lighter, it is heavier than here, about 60% denser than here.

When carbon dioxide gets pass through lime water it turns into milky color for short time.
And the reaction is calcium hydroxide plus carbon dioxide gives calcium carbonate and water.
That calcium carbonate is insoluble white substance and lime water seems milky color.
For long time when carbon dioxide gas pass through the lime water then the milky color gets disappeared.
Because carbon dioxide react with water and calcium carbonate that gives insoluble calcium by carbonate.
When carbon dioxide gas heated with ammonia gas gives you the carbon dioxide plus ammonia gives you the water.
When uses of carbon dioxide gas plant use carbon dioxide and water for photosynthesis or food making process.
Lips contain chlorophyll which convert carbon dioxide and water in presence of sunlight into sugar and oxygen.
Carbon dioxide gas is used in manufacturing of urea which is nitrogen rich chemical fertilizer needed for growth and development of plant.
When carbon dioxide is cooled about minus seventy-eight degree Celsius it changes to dry ice.
Dry ice is used in cold storage as a cooling agent or in a dry cleaning of clothes.
